external_unit_recipe: MoGe v2 declares 0.1 but the raw-to-preprocessed unit chain is unverified; do not use as certified meters
allowed_conditional_evaluation: Fit one global positive depth-unit/scale conversion from Calibration0000 only, freeze and apply to Test0001; this is scale-calibrated native-unit evaluation, not raw metric zero-shot evaluation
GT_mask: Finite strictly positive native EXR depth; keep sky Inf invalid; no outcome-dependent depth cut
prediction_invalid_on_valid_GT: STOP and report; do not filter away bad predictions
primary_error: Absolute relative error in matched native units after calibration-only global scale
risk_ties: Uniform-permutation expected prefix risk; never favorable pixel order
ECE: Only for a named event after a separate Calibration0000 probability mapping; raw score gets no ECE
probability_event_if_used: AbsRel > 0.2 after the frozen global scale conversion
probability_mapping_if_used: One-dimensional monotone logistic fit on Calibration0000 stride8 grid only; nonnegative risk coefficient; no test fitting
confidence_intervals: One independent test sequence is insufficient for cross-sequence CI; report all three frame results and macro means, no pixel-iid significance
subgroup_thresholds: GT distance terciles and RGB Sobel texture quartiles fixed from Calibration0000 only; image border 5%; GT relative depth-gradient >0.05 is a boundary proxy, not semantic GT
bin_grid_restore: Pixel-center bilinear 154x266 to canonical616x1064; identical unpad; bilinear to source GT grid
initial_depth_error: Use same global conversion fitted from final depth; do not fit a separate scale to the initial depth
physical_metric_accuracy_decision: BLOCKED until raw GT physical units are independently verified
